subject: Accounting of Non Corporate Entities
text: ECOCHIC, a retail store, has two departments, ‘Sustainable Fashion and Fast Fashion’ for each of which stock account are kept. All the goods supplied to each department are debited to the stock account at cost plus a ‘mark-up’, which together make-up the selling-price of the goods and in the account of the sale proceeds of the goods are credited. The rate of ‘Markup’ for Sustainable Fashion is 33-1/3% of the cost for departmental transfer and 50% for sale in the open market and for Fast Fashion it is 10% of the cost for departmental transfer and 50% for sale in the open market. Prepare Departmental Trading and Profit & Loss Account and General P& L A/c based on trial balance and information provided below Sustainable Fashion   Fast Fashion Particulars Rs   Rs Opening Stock   2,50,000   6,25,000 Purchases   17,50,000   43,75,000 Carriage Inward   5,11,987   12,79,967 Sales (Open Market only)   26,02,985   65,07,462 Sales Returns (from open market)   1,02,985   2,75,000 Purchase Return   1,45,000   2,55,000 Other Expenses of the company Legal fees   43,899 Audit fees   65,700 Rent   6,03,954 Salaries   6,02,063 Bad Debts   2,02,000 Power and Fuel   8,01,024 General Expenses   4,01,990 Other Information Closing Stock for Sustainable Fashion Rs 3,00,000 and Fast Fashion Rs 4,25,000

text: Sustainable Fashion department transferred goods costing Rs 1,00,000 to Fast Fashion department, the entry for the same needs to be provided. Further 10% stock remains unsold as of 31st March 2025

text: Sales Ratio for the purpose of apportionment to be taken at Net Sales inclusive of sale in open market and interdepartmental transfer. Purchase Ratio for the purpose of apportionment must be Net Purchases.

text: Rent and Salaries to be apportioned in the ratio of 2:1 between ‘Sustainable Fashion and Fast Fashion’ respectively.

text: Power and Fuel and General Expenses to be allocated equally. As per the accounting policy of the company returns to be recorded separately as a book entry and not adjusted against purchases/ sales. You are also required to prepare working notes for calculation of Net sales and Net Purchases. Round off upto two decimal points. 2.   A.
